wordpress.baseline:
tracy_site: THIS site's content, as the person you work with. Call {action, params}. An answer's `normalized` lists what Tracy corrected in your call: use that form next time.
content.replace: changes words already on THIS site in one call. Use when the customer quotes old words or names a place, and gives new ones. Not for pictures, sections or links (content.update) but links the theme prints: changes:[{find:old href,replace,href:true}]. Call {find, replace, path?:"/", where?:topbar|header|main|footer|title, all?:true only for "everywhere" or a phone/e-mail/address, at?:[…], expect?:n, changes?:[{find,replace}], dryRun?}. Returns {changed:[{at, where, before, after}], undo}: the receipt; read nothing before or after. Effects: writes the record showing the words; dryRun (needs replace) writes nothing; undo: the answer's, as given. All but X: dryRun {find, replace, all:true} lists each place (at, count); then at:[the wanted]. stillHolds: lines left that open like the changed ones. Refusals: AMBIGUOUS → at:[…]; NOT_FOUND → page.text {match}, quote exactly; NOT_EDITABLE → tell the customer why.
page.create: a new page and its menu link in one call, in the theme's own markup. Use when the customer asks for a new page. Not for an existing one (content.replace). Call {title, body:[{title?, text}, …] in their order, menu?:{after:"<the item it follows>"}, locale?}. Returns {page:{path}, menu, verified, undo}: the receipt; read nothing back. Effects: live at once. Refusals: NOT_FOUND or AMBIGUOUS list the menus to name.
content.list · content.get · info · plugin.list · theme.list: THIS site's stored records. Use when a write needs an id or the body. Not for visitor words (page.text) or the page list (content.read {view:"pages"}). Call content.list {search?:"<part of the title>", post_type?:"page"|"wp_navigation"|"wp_template_part", name?:"<slug>", limit?:≤200, offset?, include_body?} — posts only; search matches title or slug, in every language (WordPress 0.16.0+; an older one answers LIST_SEARCH_UNSUPPORTED, whose next is the road); kind:"pattern" lists registered block patterns; content.get {kind, id | key}, kind ∈ {post, postmeta, option, templatePart, term, menuItem}: option, templatePart by key ({kind:"option", key:"blogname"}); postmeta, term by id + key. Returns rows {id, title, slug, type, status, path} (include_body:true adds content, ≤25 rows); content.get answers post_* fields. Read-only.
content.read: THIS site's map: pages, articles, shared parts. Use it to find page fields. Not for writing. Call {view:"pages", url} for a known URL or {view:"pages", search:"<title>"} to find a page (OR: search:[…], ≤8); then {id}. {describe:true} for types/fields; follow links.next. Returns opaque Content API ids; native: CMS {kind, id|key}. Read-only. Refusals: CONTENT_BAD_QUERY names the field.
content.find: which file holds a string the customer sees, and the door that changes it. Use when the words are the software's own ("Read more", a form label). Not for records (content.list) or a grep of the webroot. Call {text}. Returns {matches:[{layer, door, file, line}], notSearched}. Read-only.
page.text: the words a visitor reads on a page of THIS site, as served now. Use it to find where a text is, a page's parts when the customer names a position, or its SEO tags. Not after a words write (its answer is the check); not for looks (page.look), sections or the page list (content.read {view:"pages"}). Call {path:"/", match?, maxChars?:≤8000, outline?:true, head?:true, paths?:[…≤8]}. Returns {url, lang, title, text}, text ≤2,000 chars unless maxChars; match keeps the lines holding it ("@" for e-mails, a few digits for a phone) plus pictures:[{near, src}] in their card; outline: one line per part, "<topbar|header|main|footer> <h1|p|button|nav|logo|text>: words [href]"; head: description, robots, canonical, og, hreflang, jsonLd, headings, alt-less images; robots.txt or a sitemap reads as lines; paths: {pages:[…]}. Read-only. Refusals: BAD_PATH → a path starting with one "/"; status:404 → no such path.
page.look · media.scan · media.draw · media.upload: a page's look, the site's pictures. Use when asked about either. Not for words (page.text). Call page.look {path:"/", style?:{text|selector, nth?:0 = the first, props?, viewport?}} · media.scan {limit?:≤100} · media.draw {prompt, like?:"<a site picture>" | aspect?:"16/10"} · media.upload {file, alt?} (Files-tab name) | {attachment, alt?} (attached in chat: name or sha256) · media.delete: preview, confirm; no shell/files; report refusals.. Returns {file, url, description?}: follow its next · style: each prop's value, rule and var(--token) source · the largest images {path, url, width, height} · {path}. Effects: media.draw adds ONE picture per call: write its path where it belongs. Refusals: NO_BROWSER → page.text.
content.update: changes one record. Use when settings change or content.replace cannot. Not for slot keys: the words live inside post_content. Call — post {kind:"post", id, fields:{post_title|post_content|post_excerpt|post_name|post_status}} (an edit names its id; without one it CREATES a post) · option {kind:"option", key, fields:{value}} · templatePart {kind:"templatePart", key:"header"|"footer", fields:{content, title}} · postmeta {kind:"postmeta", id, key, fields:{value}} · term {kind:"term", id, key:"<taxonomy>", fields:{name}}. A body (post_content, a part's content) goes by blocks: content.get {…, outline:true} numbers them, with rev (always over 16,000 chars), block:i reads one; {rev, blocks:{"<i>":"<markup>"|null, "+<i>":"<markup>"|{pattern:"<name>"}}} changes, drops or adds just those; a key may be a block's own metadata.name, a value {find,replace} (find stands once in it) or {attrs:{…}} (metadata, lock; any attr of a /--> block; null removes one). In fields: the WHOLE body (shorter: BODY_SHRINK). Returns {kind, id, key, created, verified}: the receipt. Effects: live at once; apply.revert undoes it.
content.delete · content.language · language.install · apply.revert · apply.list: delete, translate, undo. Use when a page goes, a language comes or a change is undone. Not for words (content.update); apply.list never after a write: the write's answer is the receipt; with no apply_id before any write: the site's recent changes. Call content.delete {kind:"post", id} · content.language {id, lang, translations?:{<lang>:<id>}} · language.install {locale} · apply.revert {apply_id} · apply.list {apply_id?}. apply_id is optional: left out, Tracy makes one per write. Returns receipts; apply.list {apply_id, steps}. Effects: a delete trashes; apply.revert undoes one apply to the byte.
theme.install · theme.activate · theme.style · plugin.install · plugin.activate · db.tables · db.dump · core.manifest: what THIS site RUNS. Use when installing a theme or plugin. Not for content or reading it (content.get/list). Call db.dump {table, limit?, cursor?} · theme.install | plugin.install {url:"https://….zip"} · theme.activate {stylesheet} · theme.style {style} · plugin.activate {file:"<dir>/<file>.php"}; install, then activate: two calls. Returns the receipt. Effects: live at once. Refusals: dump_failed → db.tables for the real name.
Tiers: reads run freely; writes run at once, undoably, but hiding, site-wide, 6+ places or money ask too; content.delete takes every language of a record unless locale names one; destructive (media.delete, content.delete, theme.install, theme.activate, plugin.install, plugin.activate): call first; CONFIRM_FIRST gives the one question, then the same call with confirm:true.
A refusal's next is the fix; a toolset it names is the role the customer needs. Content written here is in the site database, not a file commit.

Effects: media.draw adds ONE picture per call: write its path where it belongs. Refusals: NO_BROWSER → page.text.
content.update · content.delete: add, edit, move or trash one record of THIS site. Use when settings change or content.replace cannot. Not for words the software prints (content.find). Call content.update {kind, id, fields, apply_id} — id left out (or 0) CREATES one; on an existing record parent_id / move_after MOVE it with everything under it; fields.params (or attribs, images, urls, metadata) as {patch:{…}} merges into the stored column (null removes a key; a key held as JSON text (jatools-config) is patched as an object, never re-typed) · content.delete {kind, id, apply_id}. apply_id names the receipt: one per item of the request. Returns {kind, id, created}: the receipt. Effects: live at once; a delete TRASHES (nothing is purged); apply.revert {apply_id} undoes that item, an insert included. Refusals: a kind that cannot be created or moved is refused by name.
site.identity: THIS site's name, its description and whether page titles carry the name — one value for every page (Joomla's global configuration). Use when the customer renames the site, or the name every page shows in the browser tab or the header. Not for a heading of one page (content.replace). Call {operation:"read"} · {operation:"set", fields:{sitename?, MetaDesc?, sitename_pagetitles?:0|1|2}}. Returns {fields, changed}: the receipt; normalized names its apply_id. Effects: live on every page at once; apply.revert {apply_id} undoes it. Refusals: unsupported → only those three fields.
apply.revert · apply.list: undo one apply, or say what it changed. Use when the customer asks to undo a change, or what one did. Not for words (content.update); apply.list never after a write: the write's answer is the receipt; with no apply_id before any write: the site's recent changes. Call apply.revert {apply_id} · apply.list {apply_id?}. Returns {reverted} · {apply_id, steps}. Effects: apply.revert undoes one apply to the byte.
db.snapshot · db.rollback · db.tables · db.dump · core.manifest · extension.install · extension.enable · core.upgrade: what THIS site RUNS. Use when installing or upgrading. Not for content or reading it: content.get/list, never db.dump. Call db.snapshot {tables?} FIRST · db.rollback {tag} · db.dump {table, limit?, cursor?} · extension.install {url:"https://….zip"} (the site downloads it; no uninstall) · extension.enable {type, element, folder?, enabled, apply_id} · core.upgrade {to:"4.4"|"5.4"|"6.1", step:"prepare"|"finalise"}: ONE hop, two separate calls. Returns {tag} from db.snapshot. Effects: live at once; db.rollback {tag} undoes. Refusals: dump_failed → db.tables for the real name.
Tiers: reads run freely; writes run at once, undoably, but hiding, site-wide, 6+ places or money ask too; content.delete takes every language of a record unless locale names one; destructive (media.delete, content.delete, db.rollback, extension.install, extension.enable, core.upgrade): call first; CONFIRM_FIRST gives the one question, then the same call with confirm:true.
A refusal's next is the fix; a toolset it names is the role the customer needs. Content written here is in the site database, not a file commit.

emdash.baseline:
tracy_site: THIS EmDash site's page tools (content.read, page.text, page.look, media.scan, media.draw, media.upload) as {action, params}; words, pictures, menus, settings: tracy_emdash. An answer's `normalized` lists what Tracy corrected in your call: use that form next time.
content.replace: changes words already on THIS site in one call. Use when the customer quotes old words or names a place, and gives new ones. Not for pictures, links or sections (tracy_emdash). Call {find, replace, path?:"/", where?:topbar|header|main|footer|title, all?:true only for "everywhere" or a phone/e-mail/address, at?:[…], expect?:n, changes?:[{find,replace}], dryRun?}. Returns {changed:[{at, where, before, after}], undo}: the receipt; read nothing before or after. Effects: writes the field showing the words, published; dryRun (needs replace) writes nothing; undo: the answer's, as given. All but X: dryRun {find, replace, all:true} lists each place (at, count); then at:[the wanted]. stillHolds: lines left that open like the changed ones. Refusals: AMBIGUOUS → at:[…]; NOT_FOUND → page.text {match}, quote exactly; NOT_EDITABLE → tell the customer why.
page.create: a new page and its menu link in one call, in the theme's own markup. Use when the customer asks for a new page. Not for an existing one (content.replace). Call {title, body:[{title?, text}, …] in their order, menu?:{after:"<the item it follows>"}, locale?}. Returns {page:{path}, menu, verified, undo}: the receipt; read nothing back. Effects: live at once. Refusals: NOT_FOUND or AMBIGUOUS list the menus to name.
content.read: THIS site's map: pages, articles, shared parts. Use it to find page fields. Not for writing. Call {describe:true} once, then {type:"page", locale} or {view:"pages", url:link}; then {id}; follow links.next. Returns opaque Content API ids; native: CMS {kind, id|key}; a field's key is its tracy_emdash field, slug its entry id: content_get {collection, id:<slug>, locale} (collection: the site context's rule; a shared part: site). Read-only. Refusals: CONTENT_BAD_QUERY names the field; CONTENT_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED → no map here: tracy_emdash content_get.
page.text: the words a visitor reads on a page of THIS site, as served now. Use it to find where a text is, a page's parts when the customer names a position, or its SEO tags. Not after a words write (its answer is the check); not for looks (page.look), sections or the page list (content.read {view:"pages"}). Call {path:"/", match?, maxChars?:≤8000, outline?:true, head?:true, paths?:[…≤8]}. Returns {url, lang, title, text}, text ≤2,000 chars unless maxChars; match keeps the lines holding it ("@" for e-mails, a few digits for a phone) plus pictures:[{near, src}] in their card; outline: one line per part, "<topbar|header|main|footer> <h1|p|button|nav|logo|text>: words [href]"; head: description, robots, canonical, og, hreflang, jsonLd, headings, alt-less images; robots.txt or a sitemap reads as lines; paths: {pages:[…]}. Read-only. Refusals: BAD_PATH → a path starting with one "/"; status:404 → no such path.
page.look · media.scan · media.draw · media.upload: a page's look, the site's pictures. Use when asked about either. Not for words (page.text). Call page.look {path:"/", style?:{text|selector, nth?:0 = the first, props?, viewport?}} · media.scan {limit?:≤100 | id} · media.draw {prompt, replaces:{collection, id, field} | aspect:"<w>:<h>" (a new picture)} · media.upload {file, alt?} (Files-tab name) | {attachment, alt?} (attached in chat: name or sha256). Returns {file, url} · style: each prop's value, rule and var(--token) source · {id, alt, url}, id: the picture · {id, url}. Effects: media.draw adds one picture per call: write its id with tracy_emdash content_update. Refusals: NO_BROWSER → page.text.
Tiers: reads run freely; writes run at once, undoably, but hiding, site-wide, 6+ places or money ask too: call first; CONFIRM_FIRST gives the one question, then the same call with confirm:true. Nothing here is destructive.
